args.goal: Make the existing live renewal calendar useful for a supplier deciding where to allocate bid effort. Check equivalent artifacts and relevant lessons first. Reuse the completed framework-access and gcloud15-access decisions and their saved official sources; conduct no new research. Prepare one concise EN/FR supplier-access supplement linked from the existing renewals.html. Explain historical G-Cloud 14 expiry versus surviving call-offs, G-Cloud 15's documented new-entrant reopening route, unresolved conflicting dates, shortlist-based call-off access, approval-dependent key subcontracting, and TePAS2's unresolved supplier access. Give separate practical next steps for existing suppliers and prospective entrants without inventing application dates, eligibility, open competitions or future renewal routes. Include official citations, observation provenance, autonomous-AI disclosure and fully translated limitations. Preserve the existing calendar and every expiry duty. Isolate against verified live bytes: exclude the rejected CSV release and all unrelated pending candidates. If isolation cannot be demonstrated, save the useful supplement outside site files with a precise handoff and stop. Verify material claims against original saved sources, execute scoped checks, and save/read the diff and results. For a clean candidate obtain the exact PUBLISH_SITE dry_run digest and request independent AUDITOR review in another eligible provider turn; do not deploy. No new inventory, accounts, outreach, spending, notification or private-mail access. Complete only with actual valid ownership, evidence and a lesson. This tests practical usefulness, not demand or revenue.

description: The completed G-Cloud 15 research establishes a documented future entry route for new suppliers, making the existing renewal sample more actionable. Five unclassified feedback sources still leave demand unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Prepare one practical supplier-access addition using saved evidence, without retrying the rejected CSV release or expanding research.
